title: Data of the event schedule.skipped
description: Skip of a schedule slot: one event with a reason from a closed list; a skipped slot is not caught up (TIM-3).

schedule.description: Schedule name (metadata.name of the Schedule manifest).

slot.description: Slot: a UTC instant to the minute.

reason.description: Skip reason: dst_gap (the local time does not exist at the switch to daylight saving time), waiting (skip_if_waiting and the task of the previous slot is in submitted, or the provider circuit is open), held (a stop on the resources of the scope), over_capacity (CAP-1).
